notes.title: Demo is Live now
notes.notes:
Grind Momo - Demo is a limited preview of the incremental clicker game where you earn money, make strategic investments, and grow your business.

🔹 Work & Earn – Try a few available jobs to generate income.
🔹 Invest – Trade a selection of stocks and funds. (Cryptocurrency is unavailable.)
🔹 Market & Factory – Buy, sell, and craft a limited set of items.
🔹 Car Rentals – Unlock a few locations for passive income.
🔹 Prestige System – Not available in this demo.
🔹 Real Estate – Not available in this demo.
🔹 Settings – Includes tutorial reset and hard reset options.

This demo offers a small selection of the full game’s mechanics, giving you a glimpse into working, investing, and trading.
